body_html: Overall everything went great with nothing out of the ordinary and a great show overall. However we were running about a half hour to 45 minutes behind – entirely due to the photographer and I was unable to make up for that loss of time in the end. “,”The Pines at Genesee is such a beautiful mountain wedding location, yet still just a few minutes outside of Denver. This place is awesome and man do blue uplights really make this place glow! Between the lights, the ceremony, and the reception, this place was a party all night! By the time we finally go to open dancing, the dance floor was overflowing within the first 2 minutes of the first song! What a great wedding and1 congratulations to our newly weds! Another awesome wedding by JAMMIN’ DJs and DJ Cameron Jackson
